author: KrillinDeathCnt
quote: If I wanted a game that pretty much played itself, I would just watch a movie. This game doesn't hand hold you, it bundles you up in a baby carrier and carries you to the end. Thankfully I didn't buy this, but my friend did and I played it at his place. If you have the urge to buy this game, just take 70 plus dollars, just throw it out the window, you'll thank m later.
